architecture_change.old: two independently accounted cores with optional routing
architecture_change.new: one shared exact state with switchable mathematical operators
architecture_change.principle: operator switching may reuse exact state, but all prior work remains charged

first_gate.name: NEAR4_INVERSE_PAIR_TO_RELATION_SEEDED_ORBIT
first_gate.certificate: For odd N, if x^2 - N = y^2 + 4, define inv2 = 2^{-1} mod N, u=(x-y)inv2 mod N and v=(x+y)inv2 mod N. The kernel must verify u*v mod N = 1 before using u or v as an orbit base.
exact_checks: every returned factor g satisfies 1 < g < N and N mod g == 0
first_gate.switch_rule: RELATE scans its frozen budget in increasing x. On the first exact lower-square gap epsilon=4 certificate, it stops relation scanning and switches to NORMALIZE_NEAR4 then relation-seeded ORBIT. An exact factor found earlier terminates normally.
first_gate.seeded_orbit: Run the same frozen incremental collision/order machinery with relation-derived base u; if u is non-coprime, gcd(u,N) is an exact factor receipt. Before orbit escalation, try gcd(u-1,N) and gcd(u+1,N), charging both gcds. The original base a is retained only as fallback/reference, not mixed into the same collision certificate.
first_gate.comparison: Compare seeded ORBIT from u against unseeded incremental ORBIT from the original base a under the same transition cap. Relation scan and normalization costs remain charged in unified total work.

blind_holdout.geometry: SKEWED semiprime generator; no filtering on epsilon, factor gap, order, or result after generation
blind_holdout.hidden_factors: p,q may be used only by the evaluation oracle after solver execution

budgets_and_accounting.work_proxy: modular multiplications + integer square/multiplication tests + gcd operations + trial divisions
budgets_and_accounting.memory: peak stored orbit residues and relation-state units reported separately

frozen_verdict_rules.eligibility: A blind case is NEAR4-eligible only if the frozen relation scan reaches an exact epsilon=4 certificate before an exact factor and before budget exhaustion.
frozen_verdict_rules.insufficient_near4: If fewer than 6 blind cases are NEAR4-eligible, verdict is UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_NEAR4_EVIDENCE regardless of historical performance.
frozen_verdict_rules.G1_exactness: all returned certificates/factors must verify exactly
frozen_verdict_rules.G2_conditional_compression: Among NEAR4-eligible blind cases, relation-seeded orbit must reduce median orbit transition count versus unseeded orbit and achieve strict transition reduction in >= 60% of eligible cases.
frozen_verdict_rules.G3_paid_total_work: Among cases where both produce a factor/order certificate, median charged unified work (including relation+normalization) must be <= standalone unseeded orbit work.
frozen_verdict_rules.G4_strong_baseline: Report versus BSGS/rho-like strong baselines; no success claim from beating linear scan.
frozen_verdict_rules.overall_PASS: G1,G2,G3 pass with >=6 eligible blind cases.
frozen_verdict_rules.overall_FAIL: At least 6 eligible blind cases exist and G2 or G3 fails.
frozen_verdict_rules.overall_UNKNOWN: eligibility/evidence threshold is not met or resource limits prevent the frozen scope.

forbidden_promotions: No polynomial-time factoring claim from finite ladders
No post-hoc change to epsilon, budgets, thresholds, seeds, or operator order
